- The changes primarily consist of updating the Spark service version from `1.2.0.2.2` to `1.2.1` across various files. - The renaming of other files reflects a systematic migration from the old versioning scheme to a new one (`1.2.1`), ensuring consistency across the service's configuration and script files.

- The edits in the HDP stack metainfo files indicate a broader integration of the updated Spark service version into the Ambari framework, ensuring that dependent services reference the correct version of Spark to maintain compatibility and functionality.
